title: product-surface-readiness
universal_lens: Product surface readiness forms a topological coverage space where route verification defines open sets. The RED status indicates non-contractible loops in the navigation complex — missing Player Lab, team pages, GSE Rating, search, and locked states create homology generators obstructing global section existence. Build cards act as cochain corrections to trivialize obstruction classes.
gsi_mapping: GSI Bayesian inference maps route verification evidence to posterior readiness probability. Each evidence file (source-map, verification-run, route-matrix, mobile-screenshots) constitutes a likelihood factor. Missing route proofs are censored observations inducing posterior mass at RED. BUILD-REALAPP execution provides interventional data shifting posterior toward GREEN via do-calculus on the build dependency graph.
gse_mapping: GSE state-transition system models readiness as a Markov decision process with states {RED, GREEN}. Missing routes define absorbing RED substates. Evidence files form observation sigma-algebra. BUILD-REALAPP cards are control actions with transition kernels estimated from route-verification-matrix.csv. Locked/upgrade states introduce partial observability requiring belief-state updates via particle filtering on mobile-screenshot-review.md.

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: H_1(Nav) = Z^k where k = count of missing route proofs (dimensionless); Nav = navigation complex (topological space); each missing route = 1-cycle generator (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: Navigation graph is a simplicial complex; each verified route fills a 1-cycle; homepage and board are 0-simplices with verified status; evidence files provide chain homotopies
primitives.breakdown_regime: When k >= 1, H_1(Nav) != 0 implying non-trivial fundamental group; readiness status cannot be GREEN (global section obstruction); breakdown is singular at k=0 transition

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE belief-state observability: missing routes = unobserved state dimensions; route-verification-matrix.csv = observation matrix C; BUILD-REALAPP = control input u_t; RED status = belief entropy > threshold
layer2.telemetry: Route verification matrix rank deficiency (dimensionless); count of missing route proofs (integer); homology group rank (integer)

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Sigma = sigma-algebra generated by 4 evidence files (dimensionless); each file = measurable set (dimensionless); completeness = |Sigma_observed| / |Sigma_required| (dimensionless ratio in [0,1])
primitives.assumptions: Evidence files are independent measurable sets; route-verification-matrix.csv is the minimal sufficient statistic; mobile-screenshot-review.md provides visual confirmation sigma-algebra; source-map.md defines the sample space
primitives.breakdown_regime: Completeness < 1.0 when any evidence file is missing or stale; singularity at completeness = 0 (no evidence) where posterior = prior; breakdown when route-verification-matrix.csv rank < number of routes

layer2.mapping: Derives GSI likelihood function: L(theta | evidence) = prod_{f in Sigma} p(f | theta); each evidence file contributes factor; route-verification-matrix.csv provides binomial likelihood for route coverage; mobile-screenshot-review.md provides Gaussian likelihood for visual fidelity
layer2.telemetry: Evidence file count (integer); route-verification-matrix.csv row count (integer); mobile screenshot coverage percentage (dimensionless ratio)

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: B = set of BUILD-REALAPP cards (dimensionless); dependency graph G = (B, E) where E = prerequisite edges (dimensionless); execution time T: B -> R+ (seconds); readiness functor F: G -> {RED, GREEN} (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: BUILD-REALAPP cards are partially ordered by dependencies; each card execution verifies one or more missing routes; docs-only readiness is a morphism that does not factor through execution; green marking requires natural transformation from execution to status
primitives.breakdown_regime: Cyclic dependencies in G cause deadlock (singularity); parallel execution limited by dependency width; breakdown when critical path length > sprint horizon; docs-only readiness creates false positive (non-injective functor)

layer2.telemetry: BUILD-REALAPP card count (integer); dependency graph depth (integer); execution completion rate (dimensionless ratio); critical path duration (seconds)

The navigation complex Nav has 0-simplices (homepage, board) verified, but 1-simplices (Player Lab, player pages, team pages, GSE Rating, search/autocomplete, locked/upgrade) lack route proofs — these are missing edges in the 1-skeleton. The homology group H_1(Nav) = Z^6 captures six independent non-contractible loops. The evidence files form a Cech cover: real-app-source-map.md defines the site, app-verification-run.md provides stalks, route-verification-matrix.csv gives transition functions, mobile-screenshot-review.md validates gluing. The RED status is the non-vanishing of the obstruction class in H^1(Nav, O^*) where O^* is the sheaf of verified routes. BUILD-REALAPP cards are cochain corrections c in C^0(Nav, O^*) whose coboundary delta c kills the obstruction. The command 'Do not mark green from docs-only readiness' enforces that the section must be global, not just locally documented. This maps to GSE as a POMDP where belief state b_t(H_1) > 0 implies RED; BUILD-REALAPP execution reduces belief entropy via Bayesian update on route-verification-matrix.csv likelihood. GSI mapping uses the evidence sigma-algebra to construct posterior p(GREEN | evidence) proportional to prod p(file | GREEN). The breakdown regime occurs when route-verification-matrix.csv rank deficiency matches missing route count, making the likelihood singular.
